title: Graphic Designer
description:
Product Design: Develop new product concepts, designs, and packaging ideas based on market trends and customer requirements. Packaging Design: Design packaging for baby wipes, baby diapers, personal care products, tissues, and other FMCG products. Label Design: Prepare product labels, cartons, pouches, sachets, and other packaging artwork. Display Design: Create retail display stands, shampoo sachet hangers, product holders, and promotional materials for shops. Creative Development: Develop attractive product mockups, prototypes, and design presentations. Branding: Maintain consistency in company branding, colours, logos, fonts, and product presentation. Market Research: Study competitor products, packaging styles, and new design trends. Coordination: Work with the marketing, sales, production, and purchase teams to develop practical and cost-effective designs. Artwork Finalisation: Prepare print-ready files and coordinate with printing and packaging vendors. Product Improvement: Suggest innovative ideas to improve product appearance, usability, and market appeal.

Key Skills: Product Design,New Product Design,New Product Development,Packaging,Corel Draw,Manufacturing,3D Designing,Draw

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Job Title : Graphic Designer 
 Reports to: Design lead 
 Budget: Rs 30,000 per month 
 Experience: Minimum 2-3 years 
 Job Summary: 
 Client is seeking a highly creative and skilled Graphic Designer to develop visually appealing designs for various marketing materials, digital platforms, and branding initiatives and detail-oriented Graphic Designer with expertise in Motion Graphics and Video Editing to join our creative and content marketing team. The ideal candidate will have a strong portfolio, excellent design skills and The ideal candidate will bring stories to life through visually engaging designs, animations, and video compositions that strengthen brand presence across digital platforms. 


 Role & responsibilities 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Work closely with Content Marketing Team to translate concepts and briefs into engaging polished Creative poster design & videos that are optimized for different social platform. 
 Create engaging designs for ads, social media, email campaigns, labels & collaterals 
 Support performance marketing campaigns , designing ad variations for A/B testing. 
 Work with marketing & sales teams to align visuals with campaign goals. 
 Maintain brand consistency across platforms while adapting to trends. 
 Contribute to brand strategy with innovative design concepts. Refine designs based on team feedback and campaign performance . 
 (Good to have) Ability to Create short-form videos/motion graphics to boost engagement. 
 Create high-quality designs for marketing materials , including brochures, posters, flyers, and digital assets. 
 Work closely with creative teams, stakeholders, and vendors to ensure alignment and maximize business results. 
 Capable of playing an active role in brainstorming and idea generation with senior members of the creative department to conceptualize world-class, innovative ideas that deliver successful solutions. 
 Create product explainer videos, demos, tutorials, video infographics , etc. for our social media, YouTube channel and website. 
 Edit raw video footage, stitch into a story line and add effects/graphics/elements/music to enhance motion graphics content, CC and produce final deliverable . 
 Strong understanding of Hierarchy, Typography, Balance, Colour Use, and White Space. 
 The ability to manage multiple design projects and perform under pressure. 
 Have passion for motion design and storytelling. 
 Keeping up to date with the latest design trends, techniques standards. & continuously discover and implement new editing technologies and industry's best practices to maximize efficiency. 

 Preferred candidate profile 
 Qualifications: 
 Experience : Minimum 2-3 years of graphic design experience and video editing and motion graphics design. 
 Skills : Strong design skills, creativity, and attention to detail. Ability to produce high-quality video content tailored for digital platforms. 
 Problem-solving attitude with willingness to learn and adapt quickly. • Passion for creative design and storytelling through motion graphics. 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective collaboration. 
 Education : Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related field. 
 Software: Proficiency in design software, such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, and similar tools etc.).

Key Skills: Video Editing,Motion Graphics,Digital Marketing,Marketing Communication,Branding,Animation,Digital,Design
